playGuide.title: How to play
playGuide.p1: Pick a mystery box series and open its details to view the prize pool and published odds.
playGuide.p2: Choose draw count and shipping address, then pay — prizes reveal automatically after payment.
playGuide.p3: Wins go to your warehouse; you can ship, redeem for balance, or list on the marketplace.
playGuide.p4: New-user sets and limited events appear on the home carousel and activity section.
